questions.q: Why does Installation Project use an Auto Number record name format instead of a text name?
options: Auto Number is required for every custom object in Salesforce
These records don't need a human-chosen name, so a generated format like INST-0001 works well
Text names cannot be used on any Lookup relationship field
Auto Number is the only format that supports a Long Text Area field
questions.explain: The lesson explains Auto Number was chosen specifically because Installation Project and Service Contract records don't need a human-entered name -- a generated identifier is sufficient.

questions.q: Why is `Opportunity__c` on Installation Project created as a Lookup relationship rather than Master-Detail?
options: Lookup relationships are the only type available on custom objects
Master-Detail would force Installation Project's sharing to follow Opportunity exactly, which conflicts with the separate Lesson 4 sharing rule for the Service & Installation team
Master-Detail relationships cannot reference the Opportunity object
Lookup fields automatically roll up Annual Value to the parent
questions.explain: The lesson explains this is the same Lesson 3/4 decision carried into the field wizard: Lookup avoids coupling Installation Project's sharing tightly to Opportunity's, which would conflict with the dedicated Service & Installation sharing rule.

questions.q: According to the tab visibility table, which profile should NOT see the Service Contract tab by default?
options: System Administrator
Sales Rep / Sales Manager
Service Profile
Customer Success Profile
questions.explain: The tab visibility table sets Service Profile's Service Contract tab to Default Off -- Marcus Webb's installers don't need it cluttering their navigation, since it's Customer Success's object.

questions.q: What default value does the Install_Status__c field start with on a new Installation Project record?
options: Complete
On Hold
Scheduled
In Progress
questions.explain: The field table specifies a default value of Scheduled for Install_Status__c, reflecting that a newly created installation hasn't started yet.

questions.q: What four pieces of information does this lesson say every custom object needs set during creation in the Object Manager wizard?
options: A Flow, a validation rule, a report, and a dashboard
Label/plural label, object name (API name), record name format, and whether to launch the tab wizard
A profile, a role, a sharing rule, and a permission set
A price book, a product, a quote template, and a contract
questions.explain: The lesson lists these exact four settings as the custom-object creation path: Label/Plural Label, Object Name (auto-fills the API name), Record Name format, and the Launch New Custom Tab Wizard checkbox.
